scope: Named summits on Mount Desert Island not already in Peakery's Full 30
method: USGS GNIS summits for Hancock County (via MyTopo/TopoQuest) filtered to MDI by coordinates; park status by point query against the NPS Land Resources Division boundary layer (legacy ACAD boundary); access from trail guides and trip reports.
excluded_not_on_MDI: Dolly Hill, Bulger Hill, Little Head, Great Head (Cranberry Isles)
Beech Hill, Long Pond Hill and other mainland Hancock County hills

aliases.Western Mountain: GNIS name for the Bernard/Mansell massif, same point as Bernard Mountain

unverified: Ben's Peak (346 m, PeakVisor/OSM name near Sargent; location not confirmed)
Bernard Mountain, South Peak (Peakbagger name, 1,011 ft; no confirmed position, not a GNIS name)

peaks.name: Great Head
peaks.notes: Seaside headland above Sand Beach with its own summit marker; Great Head Trail loop.

peaks.name: Eagles Crag
peaks.notes: Ledge on Cadillac's south ridge; the 0.5-mile Eagles Crag Loop branches off the Cadillac South Ridge Trail.

peaks.name: Bald Mountain
peaks.notes: Southwest ridge of Bernard, reached by the West Ledge Trail. Inside the park (confirmed on the park map; the legacy boundary layer reads it just outside).

peaks.name: Paradise Hill
peaks.notes: Inside the park near Hulls Cove; the Paradise Hill carriage road loop circles it with Frenchman Bay views. Bike- and walk-able, no cars.

peaks.name: The Whitecap
peaks.notes: Knob north of Cadillac; reached by an unmarked path from the summit road, not a maintained trail.

peaks.name: Eliot Mountain
peaks.notes: Land & Garden Preserve, Northeast Harbor. Eliot Mountain Trail (1 mi), Charles Savage Trail and Asticou Ridge Trail reach the summit. No bikes; dog rules vary by trail.

peaks.name: Redfield Hill
peaks.notes: Land & Garden Preserve above Little Long Pond, Seal Harbor; the Redfield Hill Trail reaches the summit (confirmed). Height estimated (~300 ft) from neighbouring Barr and Mitchell Hills.

peaks.name: Barr Hill
peaks.notes: Preserve land south of Redfield Hill; crossed on the Acadia peaks traverse via the Richard Trail. No confirmed summit trail.

peaks.name: McFarland Mountain
peaks.notes: Behind park headquarters; reached by walking up an old ski slope from the weather station. NPS/URI survey mark at the top.

peaks.name: Brewer Mountain
peaks.notes: North of Eagle Lake; off-trail from Eagle Lake Road.

peaks.name: Great Hill (north)
peaks.notes: Between Brewer and Kebo; described as an easy bushwhack.

peaks.name: Great Hill (south)
peaks.notes: Second GNIS 'Great Hill', near the Park Loop Road by Kebo; reached from the road.

peaks.name: Cranberry Hill
peaks.notes: Low hill near Schooner Head Road east of Champlain. No known trail.

peaks.name: Enoch Mountain
peaks.notes: Between Champlain and the Beehive; the old trail is abandoned.

peaks.name: Halfway Mountain
peaks.notes: Next to Enoch; reached by an abandoned trail.

peaks.name: Mitchell Hill
peaks.notes: North of Northeast Harbor near Eliot Mountain; inside the park boundary, no known trail.

peaks.name: Pine Hill
peaks.notes: West of Long Pond, north of Western Mountain; no known trail.

peaks.name: Bald Hill
peaks.notes: Below Bald Mountain on the south side of Western Mountain; no known trail.

peaks.name: China Hill
peaks.notes: Near Bass Harbor; reads inside the park boundary. Verify on the park map before listing.

peaks.name: Mount Gilboa
peaks.notes: Next to China Hill near Bass Harbor; reads inside the park boundary. Verify on the park map.

peaks.name: Youngs Mountain
peaks.notes: North of McFarland, outside the park on private land (confirmed on the park map).

peaks.name: Ox Hill
peaks.notes: Seal Harbor, outside the park.

peaks.name: Ireson Hill
peaks.notes: Salisbury Cove, next to MDI Biological Laboratory; outside the park.

peaks.name: Frenchmans Hill
peaks.notes: North of Town Hill; outside the park.

peaks.name: Schooner Head
peaks.notes: Headland summit is outside the park; the park's Schooner Head Overlook is next to it by road.

peaks.name: Carter Nubble
peaks.notes: East shore of Long Pond, north of Beech Mountain; reads outside the park.

peaks.name: Hio Hill
peaks.notes: Southwest Harbor/Manset residential area.

peaks.name: Robbins Hill
peaks.notes: Seal Cove, Tremont.

peaks.name: Murphy Hill
peaks.notes: Seal Cove, Tremont.

peaks.name: Butlers Hill
peaks.notes: Seal Cove, Tremont.

peaks.name: Billings Hill
peaks.notes: Seal Cove shore, Tremont.

peaks.name: Burnt Hill
peaks.notes: Bass Harbor area, Tremont.

peaks.name: Big Rocks
peaks.notes: 36-ft knob by Bass Harbor Marsh.

verified: Bald Mountain (in park), Youngs Mountain (private) and the Redfield Hill summit trail confirmed against the official park map, 2026-10-26.
